hypotheses.K0_all_head_joint_edit_closes: Applying all nine complete post-boundary head changes jointly reproduces the declared terminal branch to numerical fidelity above 0.99999.
hypotheses.K1_spelling_terminal_branch_is_very_spar: The output-conditioned median number of heads needed for 90% branch fidelity is at most two in both spelling splits.
hypotheses.K2_unrelated_terminal_branch_is_small_co: The output-conditioned median number of heads needed for 90% branch fidelity is at most four in both unrelated splits.
hypotheses.K3_routing_only_order_is_near_output_ord: Routing-norm ordering has median k90 at most two heads worse than output-conditioned ordering in every cell.
hypotheses.K4_coherent_spelling_is_strictly_sparser: Median output-conditioned k90 is at least one head smaller for spelling than unrelated edits in both matched splits.
hypotheses.K5_terminal_branch_aligns_with_natural_e: The all-head post-boundary branch has positive Fisher alignment with the complete natural output edit in every cell.
